description: Canonical (sorted-key JSON) SHA-256 digests of the Emberworks content profile captured at 3601c0c, before its data moved to docs/concepts/emberworks: the colony sections the transitional installer (source/content-installers/littlewild-game.cts) installed for every colony pack (balancing defaults, compiled library schema, creature catalog and asset catalog), the Emberworks pack exactly as installed, the game's own storage namespace and a one-pack scenario catalog without a canonical pack (the pack was always used verbatim). The game-folders suite compares the folder profile against it.
